Being a Bringgster

Big ideas. Bold teams. Real impact — delivered.

Bringg offers the best of both worlds: real ownership and growth without the chaos of a startup or the red tape of a corporation. The team thrives on impact, collaboration, and shared success, energized by purpose-driven work. Bringg employees enjoy top-tier benefits, global flexibility, and a culture that values and supports the whole person.

“At Bringg I have always had the opportunity to challenge myself in my day to day work and also in my career growth. Having worked a few years in implementation, I was drawn to the other side of the sale. I had the opportunity to explore Presales and had the full support I needed to make the switch!”

Raquel
Sales Engineering Team Lead

“The people at Bringg make me feel I can bring my genuine self to work each day. I feel adequately challenged, supported, and appreciated. The people I’ve encountered here are some of the most passionate and high-energy people I’ve been around.“

Abhi
Senior Customer Success Manager

Values

Bringg’s values are more than beliefs — they define how we operate.

These values guide leadership, collaboration, and collective growth. Bringg's culture is rooted in trust, openness, and belonging, creating an environment where employees feel safe to stretch, speak up, and grow boldly.

Bringg values individuals for their talent, regardless of identity. Bringg offers a second home for those driven to be their best and make a positive impact.

Becoming the best version of oneself requires a safe environment—one that encourages stepping out of comfort zones to explore new ideas, learn from failure, and grow quickly.

The team takes pride in creating meaningful impact together, driven by a shared sense of purpose. Each day begins with the commitment to fulfill Bringg’s vision while realizing individual potential and aspirations.

No single person stands above the rest. Every individual at Bringg contributes and leads with unique responsibilities, yet all operate as one unified team. This collective strength is what brings Bringg to life.

Benefits

Great work starts with a great employee experience. Bringg benefits support health, happiness, and growth — inside and outside of work.

Bringg provides comprehensive, company-funded health coverage for employees worldwide. This includes high-quality care for employees and their families, ensuring consistent support and access to care across all locations.

Bringg supports employee well-being with a monthly wellness budget for mental and physical health—covering everything from fitness to mindfulness. Well-being is a top priority.

Bringg values meaningful rest, recovery, and time for what matters—whether it’s long weekends, get well days, volunteering, or birthdays. Time off is designed to support real life, helping employees recharge, celebrate, and give back to causes they care about.

 

Life Moments Time Off (Parental, Maternity, and Marriage)
Bringg provides generous paid leave for life’s most important milestones. From welcoming a new family member to celebrating marriage, employees receive the time they need to fully focus on these defining moments.

Flexibility is central to Bringg’s work model, combining in-person collaboration with the freedom of remote work to promote both productivity and work-life balance.

The little things make a big difference at Bringg. From monthly meal allowances to team events and thoughtful surprises, employees are supported both in and out of the office.

Bringg offers equity opportunities, ensuring every employee shares in the company’s growth and success.
